purpose: Thai floating phone widget design concepts; citizen web microphone calling into Genesys; agent copilot kept separate

images.extra: Concept title "01 / CIVIC MINIMAL". Most accessible friendly public service direction. White and very pale mint surfaces, emerald #047857 primary CTA, deep forest text, thin soft gray borders, 20px rounded corners, minimal gentle shadows. Solid emerald pill launcher with phone icon and label "โทรหาเรา". Citizen popup has a simple outline headset symbol in a pale green circle, particularly large clear CTA and whitespace. Agent summary is a subtle pale mint card. Feel calm, trustworthy and very easy for older adults. No gradients.
images.prompt:
Create a polished high fidelity Thai civic contact center website widget UI design concept, a crisp flat digital product mockup, not a photo. Landscape presentation board 1536x1024. Title at upper left with concept number. Show two browser viewport previews side by side: left 58% width citizen website with a small floating phone launcher at its bottom-right and an expanded 360px-wide popup immediately above it; right 42% width authenticated agent website with a taller expanded bottom-right copilot popup and its launcher below. Keep the underlying host website intentionally muted with a tidy Bangkok civic service header, short service cards, plenty of whitespace; popup is the clear hero. Both popup and launcher MUST be visibly anchored at bottom-right INSIDE EACH website viewport, not centered modals. No phones, devices, people, photographs, decorative 3D, extraneous dashboards. Modern readable Thai typography similar to Noto Sans Thai, realistic spacious paddings, clear hierarchy, 16-18px body text. Citizen view uses simple header "BKK CivicVoice", short line "แจ้งปัญหาเมือง คุยกับเราได้เลย", available status "พร้อมให้บริการ", one huge primary CTA with phone icon and exact Thai "โทรหาเจ้าหน้าที่", small helper "กดปุ่มเพื่อเริ่มติดต่อ", closing cross, and tiny "ตัวอย่างดีไซน์" label. Agent view header "Agent Copilot" and status "กำลังสนทนา", Live transcript excerpt "ไฟถนนดับที่เขตคลองเตย ช่วยตรวจสอบให้หน่อยครับ", AI summary as 3 short bullets: "ไฟถนนดับ", "เขตคลองเตย", "ต้องตรวจสอบพื้นที่". A clear district card "สำนักงานเขตคลองเตย". Bottom CTA exact Thai "ส่งเรื่องเข้าเขต" with small supporting "เจ้าหน้าที่เท่านั้น". Include tiny bottom captions "ประชาชน" and "เจ้าหน้าที่" for the corresponding viewport. No private names or phone numbers. Data is purely fictional. All Thai text must be accurately rendered. This is a design proposal, no claims that telephony is connected.

images.extra: Concept title "03 / NIGHT CONSOLE". Premium highly legible dark UI direction. Dark navy host websites and charcoal/navy popup surfaces #0F172A, slightly raised #1E293B cards, crisp off-white readable text, teal #5EEAD4 accent, prominent solid teal phone CTA with dark text, tiny cyan live dot PLUS written live status. Fine subdued slate borders, 18px rounded corners, almost no glow. Launcher is teal circular phone icon plus small adjacent "โทรหาเรา" label. Citizen panel remains extremely simple and welcoming. Agent popup has an elegant compact audio waveform ornament, three clean summary rows, an amber text urgency badge, and large teal dispatch CTA. Clear restrained design suitable for long agent shifts; no neon cyberpunk clutter.
